input.title: Fix CSV header parsing with quoted column names
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The `parseStatement` function incorrectly processes CSV headers with quoted column names by splitting them without handling quotes, leading to a mismatch in field count. Update the function to correctly parse headers when column names are quoted, so that the number of parsed headers matches the actual number of columns.

text:
The issue stems from how the `parseStatement` function in `src/ingest/parser.ts` processes the header line of a CSV file. The header is split by commas without accounting for quoted strings, which cause the number of fields to mismatch with quoted headers. 

I'll label this issue as a bug, open a draft pull request to propose handling quoted headers, and comment on the issue.
